dax_j_king: The draft reached R-F2 on Day 4. Dietrich "Tin" King was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
yaboypolarbear: Teodor Yaboypolarbe came from Rosenau, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Number 89 on the early rolls: Teodor Yaboypolarbe. The First Wave ribbon arrived with instructions about where to sew it and no needle.
Teodor Yaboypolarbe got a letter from Ilse. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.

Teodor Yaboypolarbe wrote back to Ilse and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one. Victory at Verdel Ridge. Teodor Yaboypolarbe let himself talk about leave for the first time in days. Orders assigned Teodor Yaboypolarbe to work as a rifleman. The first lesson began with what not to touch. Teodor Yaboypolarbe became a signaller today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.
A parcel from home held a comb. Teodor Yaboypolarbe has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
